usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the binary search tree in `main.wj`. It builds with `wj build`, and I ran it once through `wj run --compiled` on a test input I made up.

That run covered insert, a duplicate insert, `inorder`, `height`, `min`, `max`, a missing delete, and two deletes. One delete was of a node with two children and the other of a node with one child. All the output matched what I expected. I didn't run eit
